Introducing the Polaroid I-2.

Designed for craft, it’s the first analog instant camera with built-in manual controls. Pair it with the sharpest-ever Polaroid lens and the unique chemistry of Polaroid film, and you have an instant craft tool made for the tactile pursuit of analog photography.

      Reviews

        Product info

        Features

        • Built-in manual controls
        • Continuous autofocus 3-lens system
        • Outer and VF display
        • 6 camera modes: Aperture, Shutter, Multi exposure, Timer, Manual & Auto
        • Rechargeable battery
        • Up to 15 film packs battery life
        • Adjustable aperture range (from f8 to f64) and shutter speed
        • Accurate, human-friendly flash system
        • Handle strap & USB-C charging cable included
        • Warranty coverage

        Compatible with

        • SX-70, 600 and i-Type film

        Dimensions

        • 149.9mm x 119.3mm x 91.2mm (5.9" x 4.7" x 3.6")
        • Weight: 563 grams (1.24lbs) (without film pack)

        Connectivity

        • Bluetooth connection
        • Extended features with Polaroid app

        Battery Type

        • One Lithium-Ion Polymer Soft-Pack Battery
        • USB-C rechargeable

        Battery Life

        • The I-2 can take 28 packs of consecutive photos with a single charge The battery is designed to retain up to 82% of its original capacity after 300 charge cycles, which is typically 15-25 years of normal use.*
        • *Typical values tested under in-house laboratory conditions. Estimated against the usage profile of an average/typical I-2 user. Actual battery may vary by environment, flash usage, number of times charged, usage patterns, and many other factors.

        Outer Shell

        • ABS, PC, PMMA, Aluminum Alloy, Stainless Steel

        Field of View

        • Horizontal 43°, Vertical 44°

        Shutter System

        • Fast shutter speed 1/250
        • Exposure time range is 1/250~30s
        • Bulb mode (up to 99 hours)

        Aperture

        • Maximum f8 practical aperture
        • Available apertures: f8, 11, 16, 22, 32, 45, 64

        Lens

        • 3-element lens with continuous autofocus system

        Focal Length

        • 98mm

        Flash System

        • Vacuum discharge tube storage

        Displays

        • Outer: White (16 grayscale)
        • ViewFinder: Mono LCM, yellow display with black background

        Packaging Content

        • Polaroid I-2 Camera
        • Protective Lens Cap
        • USB-C Charging Cable (1.2m)
        • Handle Strap
        • Quick Start Guide
        • Tip sheet
        • Safety & Compliance Leaflet

        Proposition 65

        • For more information please check here.
